SELECT tier, is_current, (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS open_ended, COUNT(*) AS version_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, MIN(valid_from) AS min_from, MAX(valid_from) AS max_from, MAX(valid_to) FILTER (WHERE valid_to < DATE '9999-12-31') AS max_closed_to
FROM dim_member
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT
 COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
 COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members_total,
 COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys_total,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS current_rows,
 COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS current_members,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS members_with_multi_current,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current)=0)) AS members_no_current,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to=DATE '9999-12-31' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS members_multi_open,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current <> (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31')) AS flag_mismatch,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tier IS NULL OR tier NOT IN ('Basic','Silver','Gold')) AS odd_tier
FROM dim_member
